images.caption: AKA, BRICK ACADEMY; SCHOOL WAS STARTED  CIRCA 1799 BUT THIS BUILDING WAS BUILT IN 1809.  IT WAS STARTED  BY PRESBYTERIAN PASTOR, ROBERT FINLEY.  IT BECAME A PUBLIC SCHOOL FROM 1853 TO 1903 AND THEN THE TOWNSHIP HALL IN 1924
